transcript:
The Maiden's Tower is an important building. It is in Üsküdar, Istanbul. The tower is also called Kız Kulesi in Turkish. Many people visit this tower every year. It is a very old tower. The tower has a long history. Many stories are about this tower. Some stories are true. Some stories are not true. The tower is in the sea. It is near the shore. This makes it very beautiful. The view from the tower is nice. You can see the city from the top. Many ships pass by the tower. This is interesting to see. The Maiden's Tower is special for many reasons. One reason is its history.

The history of the tower is very rich. It has been a lighthouse. It has also been a place for soldiers. People have used the tower in many ways. The first stories about the tower are very old. They go back many years. One story is about a princess. The princess had a father. He was a king. The king wanted to protect his daughter. He heard a prophecy. The prophecy said his daughter would die from a snake bite. The king did not want this to happen. So, he put his daughter in the tower. He thought she would be safe. The princess lived in the tower for many years. She was happy there.

She saw the sea every day. But one day, a snake came to the tower. The snake was in a basket. A man brought the basket. The princess opened the basket. The snake bit her. The prophecy came true. The king was very sad. This is one story about the tower. There are many other stories too. Some stories are about love. Some stories are about war. People love to tell these stories. They are part of the history of the tower. The Maiden's Tower has been a symbol of Istanbul. Many people take pictures of it. They want to remember their visit. The tower is also a restaurant. People can eat there.

The food is good. It is a nice place for tourists. They can enjoy the view and the food. The Maiden's Tower is open all year. You can visit it in any season. In summer, it is hot. Many people go to the tower. In winter, it can be cold. But the tower is beautiful in the snow. Each season brings new beauty. The tower lights up at night. It is very pretty. The lights shine on the water. It is a magical sight. Many couples visit the tower. They like to take photos together. The Maiden's Tower is a romantic place. It is perfect for love stories. The stories of the tower make it special.

The history and the beauty attract many visitors. If you visit Istanbul, you should see the Maiden's Tower. It is an important part of the city. You will learn about its history. You will enjoy the view. There are many things to see and do near the tower. You can walk by the sea. You can take a boat ride. The boat ride is fun. It goes around the tower. You can feel the wind and the waves. It is a great experience. The Maiden's Tower is not just a building. It is a part of Istanbul's heart. Many people love it. They share their stories about it. The tower will always be a famous place.

It tells us about the past. It connects us to history. Every visit is special. Every visit is a new memory. The Maiden's Tower is a treasure of Istanbul.
